directions.heading: 8 camt.041.001.04 FundConfirmedCashForecastReportV04
directions.quote: A report provider, such as a transfer agent, sends the FundConfirmedCashForecastReport message to the report user, such as an investment manager or pricing agent, to report the confirmed cash incomings and outgoings of one or more share classes of an investment fund on one or more trade dates.

narrative.quote: A report provider, such as a transfer agent, sends the FundConfirmedCashForecastReport message to the report user, such as an investment manager or pricing agent, to report the confirmed cash incomings and outgoings of one or more share classes of an investment fund on one or more trade dates.
narrative.raw_quote:
Scope
A report provider, such as a transfer agent, sends the FundConfirmedCashForecastReport message to
the report user, such as an investment manager or pricing agent, to report the confirmed cash
incomings and outgoings of one or more share classes of an investment fund on one or more trade
dates.

narrative.quote: The FundConfirmedCashForecastReport is used to report definitive cash movements, that is it is sent after the cut-off time and/or the price valuation of the fund.

Usage
The FundConfirmedCashForecastReport is used to report definitive cash movements, that is it is sent
after the cut-off time and/or the price valuation of the fund.
